Three habits that keep plants happy.

Check before you water

Push a finger into the soil. If the top is dry, water. If it is still damp, wait a day or two.

Give it good light

Most indoor plants like bright light without harsh direct sun. Turn the pot now and then so it grows evenly.

Do not overdo it

Too much water is the most common problem. Make sure the pot drains and never leave water standing in the saucer.

Which plant is best for a beginner?

Snake plants, peace lilies and dracaena are forgiving and do well in lower light.
